title: Advanced Stylistics and Sentence Rhythm
titlePt: Estilística avançada e ritmo da frase
summary: Shape Brazilian Portuguese prose through emphasis, word order, ellipsis, parallelism, and controlled repetition.

sections.heading: Information structure and emphasis
sections.body: Portuguese word order is flexible enough to highlight old and new information. Fronting an element can create contrast, emphasis, or a more literary rhythm, but overuse sounds artificial.

examples.en: That problem, we have already solved.

examples.pt: Ao diretor cabia a decisão final.
examples.en: The final decision fell to the director.

examples.pt: Foi ela que encontrou a solução.
examples.en: It was she who found the solution.

sections.heading: Ellipsis and cohesion
sections.body: Advanced writing often omits repeated material when the meaning remains clear. Good ellipsis creates cohesion; unclear ellipsis forces the reader to reconstruct too much.

examples.pt: Alguns aceitaram a proposta; outros, não.
examples.en: Some accepted the proposal; others did not.

examples.pt: O primeiro argumento é econômico; o segundo, social.
examples.en: The first argument is economic; the second, social.
She wanted to stay; he, to leave.

sections.heading: Parallelism and controlled repetition
sections.body: Parallel structures make arguments memorable and balanced. Repetition can be elegant when intentional, but redundant when accidental.

examples.pt: Não se trata de negar o problema, mas de enfrentá-lo.
examples.en: It is not a matter of denying the problem, but of facing it.

examples.pt: Quanto mais clara a regra, menor a margem para dúvida.
examples.en: The clearer the rule, the smaller the margin for doubt.

examples.pt: O texto informa, orienta e convence.
examples.en: The text informs, guides, and persuades.

keyPoints: Word order can emphasize contrast or focus.
Ellipsis is effective when the omitted element is obvious.
Stylistic sophistication depends on control, not complexity alone.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use inversion everywhere to sound advanced.
commonMistakes.note: Excessive inversion sounds archaic or artificial.

commonMistakes.right: Alguns aceitaram a proposta; outros, não.

commonMistakes.wrong: O texto informa, para orientar e convence.
commonMistakes.right: O texto informa, orienta e convence.
